description: Implementation of PBCH encoder functions for 3GPP 5G NR, including payload generation, scrambling, CRC attachment, channel coding, and rate matching.

classes.name: pbch_encoder_impl
classes.description: Class implementing the PBCH encoding process for 5G NR, including payload generation, scrambling, CRC attachment, channel coding, and rate matching.

methods.name: payload_generate
methods.description: Generates the payload bits for PBCH encoding, including system frame number, HRF, and SSB index.

methods.name: scramble
methods.description: Applies scrambling to the payload bits using a sequence generated based on the system frame number and other parameters.

methods.name: crc_attach
methods.description: Calculates and attaches CRC checksum to the payload bits.

methods.name: channel_coding
methods.description: Performs interleaving, channel allocation, and polar encoding on the data bits.

methods.name: rate_matching
methods.description: Performs rate matching on the encoded bits to produce the final output.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Main function that performs payload generation, scrambling, CRC attachment, channel coding, and rate matching to produce the encoded PBCH message.
